messages.body: ok be honest how bad was last night
ok… last night was $464.38 😭 Chase Center did the most damage at $186, then dinner, drinks, and rides piled on.
that pushed the iPhone 45 days back, from Dec 18 to Feb 1. absolute financial jump scare.
the warriors game was worth it. the bar after was not
yeah, the Warriors game gets a pass. the bar after was just the expensive DLC nobody asked for 😭
ooh, $148.60 at Hertz? are we going somewhere 👀
it's for the healdsburg trip, planned it. relax
my bad 😭 planned Healdsburg money is innocent until proven guilty. carry on, wine country CEO.
why do I keep doordashing at 11pm 😭 second night in a row
because 11pm-you is apparently a tiny hungry capitalist with no adult supervision 😭
$43.97 on DoorDash this week. put a “kitchen closed” snack in the house before the app starts owning you.
ok what do I do about it
ok, we’re not banning DoorDash, we’re putting 11pm-you on a leash 😭
keep a freezer meal + snack ready, delete the app after dinner, and cap groceries at $83/week.
payday 🎉 bills are already handled, and your $3,000 to savings goes out at 9 like always. nothing for you to do but enjoy the tiny financial victory lap
love that. remind me I'm not rich
you’re not rich, you’re just temporarily unsupervised with a credit card 😭 keep the DoorDash money.
should I buy this record for $42?
$42 fits today, but it pushes the iPhone 4 days later. wanna let me turn this into blackjack? beat me and the record’s on the house 🃏 lose and the $42 gets invested instead.
LMAOO free vinyl. you're a terrible dealer
NOOOO 😭 me getting cooked means your record is free. enjoy the $42 win, menace 💅
😂 exactly. i’m here to make bad ideas financially interesting.
do you ever sleep
sleep is for people whose subscriptions aren’t being audited at midnight 😌
i’m always on call for your financial crimes.
wait why did hulu just charge me $19. I haven't opened it in forever
because Hulu has been quietly charging $19 every month since Jul 22. three charges, zero streams. the subscription is due again Oct 22, cancel it before it gets another cameo.
ugh remind me after the finale lol
fair 😭 Hulu gets one last episode arc, then it’s getting evicted.
ok after the iphone I want to save for tokyo in march. like $2400
done 🗼 Tokyo is queued right after the iPhone, so every sweep knows where to go next.
should I buy tickets to the Fred Again show for $40?
ok wait, $40 fits today, but it makes the iPhone 3 days later. want to blackjack me for the Fred Again tickets? 🃏
me winning hurts me too 😭 no Fred Again, but $40 is parked safely until you pick where it goes. choose its new home 👇
okkk the concert money got promoted to S&P 500 😭 future Charles is gonna pretend this was the plan all along.
rip fred again. at least it's in the S&P now
honestly? Fred got remixed into the S&P 500 😭 future-you gets the encore.
Sam just refunded your Uber side quest with $30 🙏 today has a little more breathing room.
okkk a quarter of the way to the iPhone 17 Pro 📱 $314 of $1,099 is locked in. the sweeps are kinda eating.
wait a QUARTER?? lets gooo
iPhone fund is actually doing numbers. keep this energy and don’t let Fred Again’s ghost spend it.
nopa was worth every dollar don't @ me
no @ needed 😭 a meal can be worth it. just don’t let “worth it” become your entire financial strategy.
rent just came out 😭 am I broke
nooo 😭 rent did not defeat you. you’ve got $4,999.61 in checking, so you’re very much not broke, just temporarily less powerful.
what can I spend today? thinking dinner out with maya
you’ve got $291 today, so dinner with Maya is absolutely happening. just don’t let appetizers form a coalition 😭
okkk officially halfway to the iPhone 17 Pro 📱 $555 of $1,099 locked in. eleven days at this pace, discipline looks annoyingly good on you.
halfway to the iphone is actually insane. thank you dime fr
always. you’re the one not letting the money evaporate, i’m just the tiny CFO in your phone.
movie was mid. $21 for that should be illegal
$21 for a mid movie is criminal 😭 that’s 2 days later to the iPhone 17 Pro. Netflix owes you emotional damages.
bar agricole at 9?? who's in
in
in if someone else orders the first round
and I'm NOT ordering doordash after. new era
will Penny spend $40 on DoorDash tonight?
ok the line: Penny spends $40 or more at DoorDash by 11:59 PM. i settle it off her card 🧾
bet. I'm locked in. $10 on no
$15 on yes. Penny and DoorDash are in a relationship
$5 on no. believing in you penny 🙏
NOOO Penny folded immediately 😭 YES wins at $46. Maya gets $15; Penny and Sam, pay up 💸
doordash is a lifestyle and I won't apologize
easiest money of my life
penny's doordash is a public utility at this point
the dumplings were worth it and I'd do it again

funds.name: S&P 500
funds.goodFor: Good for money you won't touch for 5+ years.
funds.fact: The boring default. Boring is the point.
funds.more: One fund that owns a slice of the 500 largest US companies. It has dipped hard in bad years and recovered every time so far. The fee is tiny.

funds.name: Nasdaq-100
funds.goodFor: Good for 7+ years and a stomach for dips.
funds.fact: Mostly big tech. Up more, down more.
funds.more: The 100 largest non-financial companies on the Nasdaq, so mostly Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia and friends. It beats the S&P in tech booms and falls harder when tech falls.

funds.name: Semiconductors
funds.blurb: US chipmakers. Big swings both ways.
funds.goodFor: Good for a small bet you can leave for 10 years.
funds.fact: About 30 companies. One bad quarter hits them all.
funds.more: Around 30 US-listed chip companies: designers, fabs and equipment makers. Chips power everything from phones to AI, but the industry runs in booms and busts, and this fund feels both.

funds.name: Memory
funds.goodFor: Good for money you are fine watching drop 40%.
funds.fact: New in Apr 2026. Narrow and volatile.
funds.more: Roundhill's Memory ETF, launched April 2026. About 75% of it is three companies: Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix. Memory prices swing hard, so this is the riskiest fund here by a mile.

funds.name: Cash
funds.fact: It won't grow much. It won't shrink either.
funds.more: A high-yield savings account. The balance never goes down, and it earns a little interest. Right for money you need soon, wrong for money you want to grow.
